00.name: Success
00.detail: The command completed without a firmware-detected error.

03.name: Parser timeout
03.detail: A complete CR LF terminated frame was not received.

04.name: UART 8251 error
04.detail: Parity, framing or receiver overrun error.

05.name: Syntax or parameter error
05.detail: Unknown command, invalid parameter or prohibited configuration.

07.name: Invalid track
07.detail: The track number or formatter variant is not supported.

08.name: No card / invalid sensor state
08.detail: The card position does not meet the command conditions.

09.name: 400D failure
09.detail: The Shutter procedure did not receive confirmation.

10.name: Transport timeout
10.detail: The expected sensor change did not occur.

11.name: XOR/LRC error
11.detail: The checksum of the read record is invalid.

12.name: Write/verify error
12.detail: The written data and verification read do not match.

14.name: Parity error
14.detail: A track symbol has invalid parity.

17.name: Incomplete acquisition
17.detail: A complete data stream was not acquired.

18.name: Invalid length or end
18.detail: A valid end of record was not found.

19.name: No synchronization
19.detail: The decoder did not find a synchronization pattern.

20.name: Invalid start / framing
20.detail: A valid start of record was not found.

65.name: LCD timeout
65.detail: The optional LCD controller did not change the required line.

010.description: Software restart after returning the response.

04tX.description: Set the start marker for track t.

05tX.description: Set the end marker for track t.

06td.description: Set symbol width; the parameter is not safely validated.

0701…0709.description: Set the number of magnetic read attempts; 0703 is the default.

080S.description: S mode: 8-bit, without final LRC verification.

080B.description: RAW mode: an 800-bit buffer represented as ASCII 0/1.

080V.description: V mode: T1/T3 as hexadecimal bytes; T2 remains 5-bit.

120.description: Check card presence using the sensors; no movement.

18t.description: Read track t during MFW movement.

20t.description: Read MRV and run procedure 055B. Observed behavior: when a card remains held at the start position, the command waits for removal and fresh insertion.

22t.description: Read MFW and return using procedure 05D5.

24t.description: Read MFW and move until sensors S0-S4 are released.

26t.description: MRV positioning followed by a read equivalent to 24t.

28t.description: Read MRV and position at S2.

52t.description: Wait for a card, read MRV and return to S1.

19t\u003cdata\u003e.description: Position, write MFW, verify MRV and return.

23t\u003cdata\u003e.description: Write MFW, verify MRV and return.

25t\u003cdata\u003e.description: Write MFW, verify MRV and release S0-S4.

27t\u003cdata\u003e.description: Write MRV, verify MFW and release S0-S4.

53t\u003cdata\u003e.description: Wait for a card, write MFW, verify MRV and return.

150.description: MFW movement until S0-S4 are released.

160.description: Complete MFW sequence through the sensors.

170.description: Conditional recovery/positioning based on sensor states.

500.description: Requires S0-S2 to be clear and waits for S4 activation.

700.description: Run procedure 055B when a card is present.

710.description: Return using procedure 05D5 when a card is present.

730.description: MRV positioning to S2 followed by a short overrun.

340.description: Return the last 800-position buffer; no new read or movement.

400D.description: Shutter procedure; missing confirmation returns status 09.

41000…41099.description: Disable or set the timer; its unit is unconfirmed.

630xxxxxxxx.description: Write eight bits to port 60h and pulse 40.7.

650\u003ctekst\u003e.description: Send text to the optional LCD controller.

810022.description: MFW through the sensors, pulse 40.7 and move to S4.

810028.description: Set 60.2 and perform a complete 05D5 return.

810030.description: Set 60.2 and conditionally release the MFW sensors.

aa.description: Load a card, read ISO track 2 and eject it at the front.

ab.description: Load a card, read ISO track 2 and eject it at the rear.

ea.description: Load a card, read the 200-bit RAW buffer from track 2 and eject it at the front.

eb.description: Load a card, read the 200-bit RAW buffer from track 2 and eject it at the rear.

ec.description: Load a card, read the 200-bit RAW buffer from track 2 and keep it at the rear internal position.

ed.description: Move the card from the rear internal position to the front internal position without ejecting it.

ee.description: Move the card from the rear internal position to the entry position; the card remains ready to be loaded again.

ef.description: From the rear internal position, return the card to the start of the mechanism and eject it at the rear; no movement occurs from the front internal position.

eg.description: From the rear internal position, move the card to the front internal position, read the 200-bit RAW buffer from track 2 and return it to the rear internal position.

eh.description: From the front internal position, move the card to the rear internal position, read the 200-bit RAW buffer from track 2 and return it to the front internal position.

ba\u003cdata\u003e.description: Load a card, write an ISO track-2 record, verify it and eject it at the front.

bb\u003cdata\u003e.description: Load a card, write an ISO track-2 record, verify it and eject it at the rear.

bc\u003cdata\u003e.description: From the entry position, write and verify an ISO track-2 record, then move the card to the front internal position.

bd\u003cdata\u003e.description: From the front internal position, write and verify an ISO track-2 record, then move the card to the entry position.

be\u003cdata\u003e.description: From the front internal position, write and verify an ISO track-2 record, then move the card to the entry position.

bf\u003cdata\u003e.description: From the front internal position, write and verify an ISO track-2 record, then eject the card from the reader.

bg\u003cdata\u003e.description: From the front internal position, write and verify an ISO track-2 record, keeping the card at that position.

bh\u003cdata\u003e.description: From the entry position, write and verify an ISO track-2 record, keeping the card at that position.

fa\u003cbits\u003e.description: Load a card, write the 200-bit RAW buffer to track 2, verify it and eject it at the front.

fb\u003cbits\u003e.description: Load a card, write the 200-bit RAW buffer to track 2, verify it and eject it at the rear.

fc\u003cbits\u003e.description: From the entry position, write and verify the 200-bit RAW buffer on track 2, then move the card to the front internal position.

fd\u003cbits\u003e.description: From the front internal position, write and verify the 200-bit RAW buffer on track 2, then move the card to the entry position.

fe\u003cbits\u003e.description: From the front internal position, write and verify the 200-bit RAW buffer on track 2, then move the card to the entry position.

ff\u003cbits\u003e.description: From the front internal position, write and verify the 200-bit RAW buffer on track 2, then eject the card even after a verification error.

fg\u003cbits\u003e.description: From the front internal position, write and verify the 200-bit RAW buffer on track 2, keeping the card at that position.

fh\u003cbits\u003e.description: From the entry position, write and verify the 200-bit RAW buffer on track 2, keeping the card at that position.

aca.description: Load a card, read track 1 and eject it at the front.

acb.description: Load a card, read track 2 and eject it at the front.

acd.description: Load a card, read track 3 and eject it at the front.

acg.description: Load a card, read all tracks and eject it at the front.

aka.description: Load a card, read track 1 and eject it at the rear.

akb.description: Load a card, read track 2 and eject it at the rear.

akd.description: Load a card, read track 3 and eject it at the rear.

akg.description: Load a card, read all tracks and eject it at the rear.

dc.description: Eject the card at the front.

dk.description: Eject the card at the rear.

haa\u003cdata\u003e.description: Load track-1 data into the write buffer.

hab\u003cdata\u003e.description: Load track-2 data into the write buffer.

had\u003cdata\u003e.description: Load track-3 data into the write buffer.

bca\u003cdata\u003e.description: Load a card, write track 1 and eject it at the front.

bcb\u003cdata\u003e.description: Load a card, write track 2 and eject it at the front.

bcd\u003cdata\u003e.description: Load a card, write track 3 and eject it at the front.

bka\u003cdata\u003e.description: Load a card, write track 1 and eject it at the rear.

bkb\u003cdata\u003e.description: Load a card, write track 2 and eject it at the rear.

bkd\u003cdata\u003e.description: Load a card, write track 3 and eject it at the rear.

bcg.description: Write all previously loaded buffers and eject the card at the front.

bkg.description: Write all previously loaded buffers and eject the card at the rear.

y\u003cconfig\u003e.description: Write the complete MMW configuration block. Read it with t first; sending y alone writes an empty block.

ac.description: Load a card, read ISO track 2 and keep it at the rear internal position.

ad.description: Move the card from the rear internal position to the front internal position without ejecting it.

ae.description: Move the card from the rear internal position to the entry position, ready to be loaded again.

af.description: Return the card from the rear internal position and eject it at the rear.

ag.description: Read ISO track 2 from the rear internal position and return the card there.

ah.description: Read ISO track 2 from the front internal position and return the card there.

da.description: Eject the card at the front.

db.description: Eject the card at the rear.

ja\u003cdata\u003e.description: Load a card, write ISO track 2 without verification and eject it at the front.

jb\u003cdata\u003e.description: Load a card, write ISO track 2 without verification and eject it at the rear.

na\u003cbits\u003e.description: Load a card, write the 200-bit RAW buffer to track 2 without verification and eject it at the front.

nb\u003cbits\u003e.description: Load a card, write the 200-bit RAW buffer to track 2 without verification and eject it at the rear.
